/images/dakughar/01-architectural-floor-.label: Three floor plans
/images/dakughar/01-architectural-floor-.reading: Compare the three levels around the same central opening. The courtyard gives a compact footprint a shared source of daylight.

/images/dakughar/02-architectural-sectio.label: Courtyard sections
/images/dakughar/02-architectural-sectio.reading: The paired sections reveal the stacked rooms and the continuous void between them.

/images/dakughar/03-architectural-explod.label: Exploded isometric
/images/dakughar/03-architectural-explod.reading: The separated roof, frame and walls make the building’s layers visible in one drawing.

/images/dakughar/08-architectural-side-e.label: Side elevation
/images/dakughar/08-architectural-side-e.reading: The long wall meets the street through a smaller opening and patterned screen.

/images/dakughar/09-architectural-front-.label: Street elevation
/images/dakughar/09-architectural-front-.reading: The tall opening and patterned upper screen give the narrow frontage its depth.

/images/episode-kolkata/11-architectural.label: Rooms around the ballroom
/images/episode-kolkata/11-architectural.reading: Follow the entrance into the ballroom, then compare the smaller rooms around its edges.

/images/episode-kolkata/12-architectural.label: Elevation A · material layers
/images/episode-kolkata/12-architectural.reading: Read the wall from the dark base upward: panelling, plaster, openings and decorative mouldings.

/images/episode-kolkata/13-architectural.label: Elevation B · sequence of rooms
/images/episode-kolkata/13-architectural.reading: This longer view connects successive chambers and their different openings.

/images/episode-kolkata/14-architectural.label: Elevation C · screens and lighting
/images/episode-kolkata/14-architectural.reading: The screens and suspended lights establish rhythm without enclosing every room.

/images/episode-kolkata/15-architectural.label: Elevation D · chamber proportions
/images/episode-kolkata/15-architectural.reading: The elevation relates the height of wall panelling to the openings between rooms.

/images/episode-kolkata/18-architectural.label: Exploded rooms
/images/episode-kolkata/18-architectural.reading: The cutaway separates the rooms while keeping their connections to the central ballroom visible.

/images/episodeone-powai/11-washroom-det.label: Timber and marble in the washroom

/images/episodeone-powai/13-architectura.label: Plan around the central planter
/images/episodeone-powai/13-architectura.reading: The triangular planted island anchors the hall. Seating and the floor pattern turn around it.

/images/episodeone-powai/14-architectura.label: Bar elevation
/images/episodeone-powai/14-architectura.reading: The counter and suspended cage form two horizontal layers, with planting between them.

/images/episodeone-powai/15-architectura.label: Bar section and floor build-up
/images/episodeone-powai/15-architectura.reading: The vertical cut brings the counter, footrail, raised floor and overhead frame into one view.

/images/house-by-the-sea/drawings-02-hou.label: Apartment isometric
/images/house-by-the-sea/drawings-02-hou.reading: Read the rooms together, tracing the relationship between shared living spaces, bedrooms and the perimeter openings.

/images/mumbai-airport-foodcourt/04-isom.label: Food-court isometric
/images/mumbai-airport-foodcourt/04-isom.reading: The overhead view makes the separate food outlets, seating clusters and routes through the concourse easier to distinguish.

/images/pet-park/09-architectural-master.label: Landscape plan
/images/pet-park/09-architectural-master.reading: Trace the perimeter path, then the smaller loops between planted areas, agility mounds and resting places.

/images/pet-park/10-isometric-masterplan.label: Terrain and paths in three dimensions
/images/pet-park/10-isometric-masterplan.reading: The oblique view shows the height of the mounds and how the paths negotiate the planted terrain.

/images/seven-gardens/13-garden-elevatio.label: Garden elevation
/images/seven-gardens/13-garden-elevatio.reading: Glazing and planting interrupt the long earth wall along the garden edge.

/images/seven-gardens/14-front-elevation.label: Front elevation
/images/seven-gardens/14-front-elevation.reading: Read the alternating solid walls and openings as a rhythm across the front of the house.

/images/seven-gardens/15-isometric-struc.label: Courtyards in isometric
/images/seven-gardens/15-isometric-struc.reading: The open roof view makes the courtyard network visible between the rooms.

/images/seven-gardens/16-courtyard-floor.label: Courtyard floor plan
/images/seven-gardens/16-courtyard-floor.reading: The open spaces are part of the plan’s organisation. Follow the rooms around the gardens rather than reading the house as a single enclosed block.

/images/social-city-mall/04-architectura.label: Interior and rooftop plan
/images/social-city-mall/04-architectura.reading: The interior seating wraps the bar; the rooftop garden continues the social floor outside the glazed boundary.

/images/social-city-mall/05-architectura.label: Bar and lantern section
/images/social-city-mall/05-architectura.reading: The section relates the overhead lantern to the bar and the stepped seating on either side.

/images/social-city-mall/07-architectura.label: Terrace and interior section
/images/social-city-mall/07-architectura.reading: This cut connects the enclosed room, glazed facade and open-air terrace.

/images/social-malad/10-architectural-lo.label: Long section through the bar
/images/social-malad/10-architectural-lo.reading: The long cut connects the steel roof, central bar and raised seating within one frame.

/images/social-malad/11-architectural-cr.label: Cross section
/images/social-malad/11-architectural-cr.reading: The transverse view shows the room’s depth from the planted edge toward the bar.

/images/social-malad/12-architectural-gl.label: Glazed facade elevation
/images/social-malad/12-architectural-gl.reading: The glazing grid forms the outer edge of the venue; the small section at the side shows its profile.

/images/social-malad/15-architectural-is.label: Venue isometric
/images/social-malad/15-architectural-is.reading: The cutaway connects the bar, stepped seating and perimeter rooms without the roof obscuring the arrangement.

/images/social-vashi/14-spatial-concept-.label: Spatial concept plan
/images/social-vashi/14-spatial-concept-.reading: The concept plan establishes the bar and seating pockets. The right-hand service wing remains schematic in this illustration.

/images/social-vashi/15-seating-and-plan.label: Seating and planting plan
/images/social-vashi/15-seating-and-plan.reading: Compare the placement of tables and planting with the first plan; the shared central space remains the organising point.

/images/social-vashi/16-bar-concept-elev.label: Bar concept
/images/social-vashi/16-bar-concept-elev.reading: Stepped masonry gives the bar its profile. The drawing studies the counter and signage at eye level.

/images/social-vashi/17-window-dining-co.label: Window dining concept
/images/social-vashi/17-window-dining-co.reading: Window-side tables occupy the lighter edge of the room beneath the continuous ceiling.

/images/social-vashi/18-banquette-concep.label: Banquette concept
/images/social-vashi/18-banquette-concep.reading: The banquette forms a quieter pocket within the same brick and timber interior.

/images/under-the-tree-karjat/05-floor-p.label: Floor plan · original drawing
/images/under-the-tree-karjat/05-floor-p.reading: The living room sits to the right of the circulation spine, with the kitchen opposite. The bedrooms occupy the upper and lower left, opening the house towards the courtyard and outdoor dining area.

/images/under-the-tree-karjat/06-archite.label: Banyan and hillside elevation
/images/under-the-tree-karjat/06-archite.reading: The low roof and heavier stone base sit against the wooded hillside.

/images/under-the-tree-karjat/07-archite.label: Section through house and garage
/images/under-the-tree-karjat/07-archite.reading: The cut shows the garage beneath the dwelling and the change of level across the site.

/images/under-the-tree-karjat/08-archite.label: House and terrain isometric
/images/under-the-tree-karjat/08-archite.reading: The open roof view relates the rooms to the ground falling away around the house.

/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/09-architec.label: Furniture layout plan
/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/09-architec.reading: The furniture plan locates the tables and circulation around the central counter.

/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/10-architec.label: Marble-shard flooring plan
/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/10-architec.reading: The same room is read through its floor finish, with scattered marble fragments held within larger fields.

/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/13-architec.label: Facade elevation and plan
/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/13-architec.reading: The elevation and small plan below it show repeating cast units held within the timber framework.

/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/15-architec.label: Counter and tile wall
/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/15-architec.reading: The repeated tile wall and suspended lights give the counter a distinct backdrop.

/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/16-architec.label: Second counter elevation
/images/unplugged-jamshedpur/16-architec.reading: A second counter study pairs the lower solid base with a panelled upper wall.

/images/the-jude-bakery-project/04-polyc.label: A translucent roof over the bakery
/images/the-jude-bakery-project/04-polyc.reading: The intervention begins above the existing bakery, with a light enclosure that changes character from daylight to dusk.

/images/the-jude-bakery-project/06-bar-a.label: The bar beneath the roof
/images/the-jude-bakery-project/06-bar-a.reading: The counter and dining area share an open room, with the roof structure visible overhead.

/images/the-jude-bakery-project/final-20.label: Communal dining upstairs
/images/the-jude-bakery-project/final-20.reading: The long table gives the upper floor a shared focus for the proposed chef dinners.

/images/the-jude-bakery-project/final-20.label: Roof and mezzanine
/images/the-jude-bakery-project/final-20.reading: The view upward connects the occupied levels to the translucent roof and exposed framing.

/images/social-malad/15-isometric-pale-v.label: Venue isometric
/images/social-malad/15-isometric-pale-v.reading: The cutaway connects the bar, stepped seating and perimeter rooms without the roof obscuring the arrangement.

/images/social-malad/12-column-facade-se.label: Column, glazed facade and section
/images/social-malad/12-column-facade-se.reading: The column pairs pale cladding with a terrazzo base. Beside it, the elevation shows the glazing grid, while the section shows its slender profile and upper junction.

/images/social-malad/10-long-section-ser.label: Long section through the bar
/images/social-malad/10-long-section-ser.reading: Ducts, cable trays and wiring run through the upper truss zone above the ceiling. The restaurant space below stays clear, with the bar and terraces gathered beneath it.

/images/social-malad/11-cross-section-sa.label: Cross section, kitchen and mall AHU
/images/social-malad/11-cross-section-sa.reading: The kitchen occupies the lower-left bay, with the mall AHU above it. Ducts and cable trays run through the space over the timber ceiling. The restaurant retains its original perspective and seating arrangement.
